steps.title: Promptly status
steps.body: This pill tells you whether Promptly is monitoring your prompts. Toggle it from the status card below.

steps.title: Turn Promptly on
steps.body: One click turns Promptly on. We only read text in the AI tools you've allowed — never anywhere else.

steps.title: Daily counters
steps.body: Risks caught are PII or policy violations Promptly stopped from leaving your Mac. Resets every day.

steps.title: Your suggestions
steps.body: These are the rewrites Promptly can apply when you ask. Click "Manage in Settings →" to enable or customise them.

steps.title: Activity Log
steps.body: Every prompt Promptly inspects shows up here so you can audit what was caught.

steps.title: Chat from anywhere
steps.body: Have a question? Press ⌘⇧P to open the floating chat — even when the dashboard is closed.

steps.title: Apply instructions
steps.body: Toggle these to apply tone, format, or language to every reply. Active chips get prepended to your message.

steps.title: Ask anything
steps.body: Type a question. ⌘↵ sends. Your active instructions are applied automatically.

steps.title: Replies appear here
steps.body: Use the trash icon in the header to clear. The conversation is in-memory only — quitting Promptly wipes it.

steps.title: Make it yours
steps.body: Build your own instructions in Settings → Custom Instructions. They show up here the next time you open chat.

steps.title: Filter by action
steps.body: Click a chip to narrow the list to risks caught, sanitised prompts, or optimised rewrites.

steps.title: Per-row badges
steps.body: Each entry shows which suggestion type ran, the app where the prompt was typed, and a short snippet.

steps.title: First-prompt banner
steps.body: When you protect your first prompt, you'll see a green banner here. Everything after that is part of your audit trail.

steps.title: Monitoring toggle
steps.body: Turn Promptly's text-field monitoring on or off. The Control Panel Activate button does the same thing.

steps.title: Custom instructions
steps.body: Reusable prompts you can apply per chat message. Toggle a row to make it active everywhere.

steps.title: Monitored apps
steps.body: Promptly only reads text in apps enabled here. Disabling an app makes Promptly invisible there.

steps.title: Suggestion types
steps.body: Click a row to expand it and see what Promptly does. Toggle to switch a type on or off.
